description: Land Acquisition - Galapitagama, Polpittaigama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Mahasiyambalagaswewa, Nuwaragampalatha Central D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and extents, along with orders for taking possession of these lands. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena), the core content is focused on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
